# VectorPaint vector design learning path

> Learn shapes, fills and strokes, then edit paths and nodes, organise layers, add gradients and text, and choose SVG, PNG or PDF for delivery.

## App and version

- [VectorPaint: vector drawing, logos and SVG editing](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/vectorpaint/index.md): Explore VectorPaint vector drawing, Bézier nodes, layers and SVG exports. Watch MCP create the 14-layer Midnight Orchid and find connection steps for MCP-enabled builds.
Version listed: 1.0.7; checked 2026-10-22; iOS 17.0+ / iPadOS 17.0+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. VectorPaint getting started: build an icon from shapes and export SVG](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-getting-started/index.md): Start with a small icon made from circles and rectangles to learn canvases, fills and strokes, layer organisation and the choice between SVG and PNG. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [2. VectorPaint canvas sizes: distinguish px, pt, mm and exported pixels](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-canvas-units/index.md): Use a square icon and a small printed card to separate canvas proportions, document units, editor zoom and final PNG pixels, avoiding repeated setup changes. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [3. VectorPaint shape practice: build a little house from rectangles and circles](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-basic-shapes/index.md): Draw a house to practise rectangles, ellipses, selection, dimensions, stacking and proportions before moving to complex path editing. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [4. VectorPaint fills and strokes: clear colour areas and consistent lines](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-fill-stroke/index.md): Compare fill, no fill, stroke width and opacity on three circles, and understand invisible objects, overly thick lines and mistaken multi-object edits. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [5. VectorPaint pen tutorial: draw a leaf with a few anchors](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-pen-curves/index.md): Move from a straight-sided triangle to a closed leaf, learning anchors, handles and curve direction while avoiding crowded nodes and kinks. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [6. Edit Bézier nodes in VectorPaint: smooth curves without adding anchors](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-bezier-nodes/index.md): Use a leaf outline to practise moving anchors, orienting handles and checking corners, separating whole-object distortion from local curve correction. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [7. VectorPaint layers and groups: make complex work easier to select and edit](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-layers-groups/index.md): Organise a small card into background, subject and text layers, learning what layers, groups, overlaps, locking and hiding each do. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [8. VectorPaint alignment and distribution: arrange three button icons](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-align-distribute/index.md): Use three different-width shapes to understand edge alignment, centring and equal distribution, distinguishing centre-to-centre distance from gaps between edges. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [9. VectorPaint grids and guides: composition references for icons and posters](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-grid-guides/index.md): Use grids, snapping and guides to control margins and positions while retaining necessary optical adjustments, and keep guides out of the finished artwork. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [10. VectorPaint text layout: make a clear event card](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-text-layout/index.md): Practise content, fonts, size, alignment and empty space through title, explanation and date levels, so the card communicates more than decoration. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [11. VectorPaint text on a path: make a curved text badge](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-text-on-path/index.md): Use a short title and simple arc to practise text along a path, adjusting direction, curvature and length while keeping the text original for later edits. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [12. VectorPaint gradients: give a circle a clear light direction](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-gradients/index.md): Begin with a two-colour linear gradient, then compare a radial gradient to understand stops, direction, opacity and readability at smaller sizes. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [13. VectorPaint mask exercise: keep a pattern inside a circular window](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-masks/index.md): Use three colour shapes and a circle to practise clipping, masks, stacking and raster boundaries without mistaking a crop for vectorisation. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [14. Import SVG into VectorPaint: inspect structure before editing paths and colours](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-svg-import-edit/index.md): Check a simple SVG import, distinguishing paths, text, raster images and masks rather than treating the extension as a guarantee of complete editability. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [15. VectorPaint image tracing: turn clear line art into editable paths](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-image-vectorization/index.md): Trace a black-and-white leaf silhouette, compare threshold, colour count and previews, and understand the trade-off between photo quantisation and path complexity. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [16. VectorPaint transparent PNG: remove the white background and check edges](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-transparent-png/index.md): Use a single-colour icon to check transparency, solid background objects and final pixels, then inspect the export on both dark and light backgrounds. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [17. Choose VectorPaint export formats: SVG, PDF, PNG and editable originals](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-export-formats/index.md): Choose a format for further editing, webpage display or document delivery, explaining the limits of raster images, text and transparent backgrounds. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [18. VectorPaint project: design a monochrome mountain icon that reads small](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-monochrome-icon/index.md): Build a mountain icon around silhouette, negative space and line width, then check recognition at 32, 64 and 128 pixels. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [19. VectorPaint project: a creative-event poster with geometric colour and text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-geometric-poster/index.md): Organise a portrait poster into title, main artwork and information areas, combining shapes, gradients, alignment and text in one complete exercise. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [20. Save and back up VectorPaint originals: find the editable file next time](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-save-backup/index.md): Use clear filenames, original-file copies and restore checks to record a project, distinguishing undo, versions, recently deleted items and independent backups. Originally published: 2026-10-22.
- [21. VectorPaint weather icons: balance sun, cloud and rain at one visual size](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-weather-icon-set/index.md): Create three weather icons using a shared baseline, line width, outer bounds and small-size previews to establish consistent visual rules. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [22. VectorPaint route diagram: explain directions with paths, stops and a legend](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-route-map/index.md): Use a simplified walking route to practise paths, numbered stops, text and a legend, making the information sequence easier to read than the decoration. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [23. VectorPaint repeating patterns: check a tile’s four edges by hand](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-repeat-tile/index.md): Start from a square tile, manually duplicate leaves and dots, check opposite-edge correspondence and use a nine-tile preview to spot seams. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [24. VectorPaint wayfinding: make consistent signs for three spaces](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-wayfinding-signs/index.md): Use fictional reading, exhibition and rest areas to practise shared arrow, text and symbol rules, checking readability from a distance and at small sizes. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [25. VectorPaint geometric portrait: describe features and hair with a few shapes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-geometric-portrait/index.md): Build a geometric portrait from the head outline, hairstyle and facial features, controlling symmetry, overlap and recognition at small sizes. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [26. VectorPaint botanical greeting card: a leafy border with room for text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-botanical-card/index.md): Arrange branches around a short greeting, practising curve direction, varied repetition, border density and text space to finish a botanical card. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [27. VectorPaint box illustration: build consistent perspective from three planes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-isometric-box/index.md): Draw a box’s top, left and right faces with the pen, use shared vertices and values for volume, then check gaps and distortion along the edges. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [28. VectorPaint bar chart: keep lengths, numbers and units consistent](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-bar-chart/index.md): Draw a three-item bar chart manually, calculate lengths to one scale and check the zero baseline, labels and data source to avoid misleading graphics. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [29. VectorPaint timeline: arrange five stages with descriptions of different lengths](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-timeline/index.md): Make a five-stage project timeline, distinguish sequence diagrams from time-scaled layouts, and handle varied descriptions, node spacing and later updates. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [30. VectorPaint three-step diagram: explain a process through continuous action](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-instruction-panels/index.md): Illustrate watering in three panels, keeping object positions and proportions consistent while using numbers, changed actions and short text to explain the process. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [31. VectorPaint wordmark spacing: adjust the visual rhythm of a short name](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-wordmark-spacing/index.md): Compare default spacing, overall tracking and local gaps for a short name, keep the editable text and check small-size and reversed-out versions. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [32. VectorPaint bilingual titles: balance Chinese, English and supporting information](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-bilingual-title/index.md): Use a Chinese–English event title to practise hierarchy, apparent type size, line spacing and alignment rather than matching font-size numbers mechanically. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [33. VectorPaint contour-style illustration: organise spacing with open curves](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-contour-lines/index.md): Draw contour-like curves by hand, practising open paths, node direction, line spacing and cropping in an abstract terrain illustration. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [34. VectorPaint two-colour overlaps: compare opacity and stacking order](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-transparent-overlap/index.md): Use two coloured shapes and a fixed background to compare object opacity, overlapping areas and front-to-back order in an explainable colour study. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [35. VectorPaint product cards: expand one reusable layout into a series](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-price-card-series/index.md): Make three fictional product cards, handling different name lengths, specifications, prices and image areas, then check for old information left after duplication. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [36. VectorPaint phone wallpaper: leave room for time, icons and the main image](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-phone-wallpaper/index.md): Match the target phone’s proportions, reserve lock-screen time and home-screen icon areas, and preview actual wallpaper settings to check cropping, contrast and subject placement. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [37. VectorPaint avatar adaptation: check circular crops and square previews](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-avatar-crops/index.md): Make square and circular checks of the same avatar, identify cropped head, shoulder and decoration areas, and preserve consistent margins and a clear small-size silhouette. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [38. VectorPaint sticker illustration: draw a white backing and check transparent edges](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-sticker-outline/index.md): Build a white backing outline by hand, handling inward corners, narrow gaps and transparent edges, and distinguish a visual sticker border from a print cut line. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [39. VectorPaint small-print checks: verify size and fine lines in a PDF proof](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-print-proof/index.md): Prepare a PDF proof for a small card, check document units, physical size, text, fine lines and trim bounds, then confirm production requirements with the printer. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
- [40. VectorPaint logo delivery: check light, dark and small-size versions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/vectorpaint-logo-handoff/index.md): Organise an editable original, SVG and PNG for a finished logo, check colour, transparency, text and small-size rendering, and explain the purpose of each file. Originally published: 2026-10-23.
